customAPI.title: Model API
customAPI.saved: Configuration saved. Model pickers have been updated.
customAPI.unsaved: Unsaved changes. Save to apply them to workflows.
customAPI.imported: Imported as new entries. Add API keys before use.
customAPI.exported: Configuration exported without saved API keys.
customAPI.localCredentials: Credentials stay on this ComfyUI server. Workflows reference configuration IDs.
customAPI.providerHint: Configure the endpoint and authentication shared by this provider's models.
customAPI.deleteProviderConfirm: Remove this provider and its model configurations? Save to apply the removal.
customAPI.welcomeHint: Add an API endpoint, choose your models, then use them directly in a workflow.
customAPI.iconHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB. You can also enter an emoji.
customAPI.keyStored: Key saved · leave untouched to keep it
customAPI.keyHint: Stored separately on the server. Editing and clearing this field removes the saved key.
customAPI.keyEnvironment: API key environment variable (overrides saved key)
customAPI.modelsFetched: Added {count} models. Assign their API templates before use. Existing settings were preserved.
customAPI.modelsHint: Select models to assign templates in bulk. Edit a model to set its name and default parameters.
customAPI.noModels: Fetch the provider's model list or add a model manually.
customAPI.upstreamModelId: Model ID sent to the API
customAPI.defaultParametersHint: Overrides template defaults. Node parameters take precedence.
customAPI.templatesHint: Define requests, response extraction, parameters and optional task polling. Duplicate a preset to get started.
customAPI.templateSecrets: Use {{api_key}} for credentials. Never paste keys directly into templates.
customAPI.invalidJSON: Invalid JSON. Fix the highlighted editor before continuing.
customAPI.testHint: Request preview does not call the provider. Run test sends a real request and may incur charges.
customAPI.previewReady: Preview ready. No request was sent to the provider.
customAPI.cancelling: Cancelling. Remote cancellation depends on the API template and provider.
customAPI.testStillRunning: A test is still running. Wait for it or cancel it before closing.
customAPI.historyHint: The last 50 calls in this server session. Credentials are redacted; large responses are truncated.
customAPI.node.name: Parameter name
customAPI.error.missing_value: A required template variable or response field is missing.
customAPI.error.config_read_failed: Could not read configuration. The file was preserved.
customAPI.error.config_conflict: The configuration changed in another window. Close this panel and reload the page before editing again.
customAPI.error.media_too_large: Image or response exceeds the size limit.
customAPI.error.model_unavailable: Select an available model in the node.
customAPI.error.provider_unavailable: The provider is missing or disabled.
customAPI.error.unsupported_operation: This model has no template for the selected operation.
customAPI.error.missing_image: This operation requires an input image.
customAPI.error.upstream_http: The provider returned an HTTP error.
customAPI.error.invalid_response: The response does not match the template.
customAPI.error.request_failed: The API request failed or timed out. A generation request was not retried automatically.
customAPI.error.download_failed: Could not download the generated image.
customAPI.error.poll_timeout: Stopped waiting for the remote task. Use its task ID to check with the provider.
customAPI.error.forbidden_origin: This request came from a different website.
customAPI.error.too_many_tests: Too many tests are running. Wait for a test to finish.
customAPI.error.job_not_found: This test has expired or the server restarted.
customAPI.error.template_in_use: This template is still assigned to a model. Remove its bindings first.
customAPI.searchIcons: Search LobeHub icons, e.g. Qwen, DeepSeek…
customAPI.iconLibraryHint: LobeHub icons are bundled for offline use. Leave unset to match the provider name.
customAPI.selectVisibleModels: Select all models in the current list
customAPI.searchAllModels: Search models, providers or model IDs…
customAPI.noCompatibleModels: No compatible models. Enable a model and assign its API template in the manager.
customAPI.selectionUnavailable: This model is disabled or its API configuration changed. Choose a model again.
customAPI.promptPlaceholder: Describe what you want the model to do…
customAPI.systemPlaceholder: Set the role, tone or output rules…
customAPI.connectImageHint: Connect an image node to the Image input above.
customAPI.nonceHint: Changing this number sends a new request on the next run. It is not a model seed.
customAPI.newRequestHint: Updates the request nonce. Press ComfyUI Run to send the request.
customAPI.networkPolicyHint: Public APIs work without an allow-list in default mode. Authorize local services separately; use an IP address such as 127.0.0.1.
customAPI.error.network_origin_blocked: This origin is not approved by the server owner.
customAPI.error.network_address_blocked: The destination resolves to a blocked network address.
customAPI.error.network_policy_invalid: The local outbound network policy is invalid.
customAPI.error.network_proxy_blocked: Explicit HTTP proxies are not supported.
customAPI.error.network_header_blocked: Host and proxy routing headers cannot be overridden.
customAPI.error.network_key_env_blocked: This API key environment variable is not approved by the server owner.
customAPI.node.requestNonceHint: Change this value for a new API request. This is not a model seed.
customAPI.node.textDescription: Call a custom text or vision API. Credentials stay on the server.
customAPI.node.imageDescription: Generate or edit images using a custom API, preserving their original sizes.
customAPI.node.parameterDescription: Build typed JSON parameters and combine them through node connections.
customAPI.network.allowed_originsHint: One origin per line, including API and image CDN origins. No paths or wildcards. Local IP origins here also authorize local access in strict mode.
customAPI.network.allowed_key_envHint: Optional, one variable name per line. Pasting a provider key does not need this setting.
customAPI.authorizeLocalConfirm: Allow this ComfyUI server to access {origin}? This authorization is saved separately and takes effect immediately.
customAPI.networkModesHint: Default mode allows public HTTP(S) destinations and separately approved local services. Strict mode uses only its origin allow-list. Special addresses remain blocked. Changes apply to subsequent requests, not connections already in flight. These settings are separate from configuration imports and exports.
customAPI.network.local_originsHint: One origin per line: http://127.0.0.1:11434. Use an exact local IP and port, without a path.
customAPI.pairingHint: For a shared or remote server, enter pairing_code from user/__custom_api/management-access.json on the server. It grants full plugin management access. Use HTTPS or a trusted tunnel for remote access. The browser keeps the session only in memory.
